notes.title: HYPERFATAL Demo Released!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019796/7b73dae9a9b550407fb11a215897ecd236cfb623.png[/img]

Today marks day one of the demo release of HYPERFATAL, and a few bugs have already been found and fixed! Any and all players are encouraged to give feedback on anything, such as bugs, ideas, thoughts on content, etc.

Bugs are especially important, as we will be patching the demo to make sure that the experience isn't hindered by anything. The game is still WIP, but we hope the content supplemented in the demo is a big enough taste to let you all know of what is to come in the future in full release.

Thank you for playing, and we hope to hear from as much people as possible!
